resources.string: Activate Shira here, or let the web page do it for you.
Your network keeps working as normal until the web page connects.
Turn on USB debugging in Developer options, and plug this phone into a computer.
On the computer, open %1$s in Chrome or Edge.
Connect your phone and enter a Wisp server. The web page shows every connection from then on.
Android needs your OK before Shira can act as a VPN.
Shira was turned off because another VPN took over, or it was turned off in Settings.
Another VPN has taken over. Open Shira on the phone and activate it again.
Another app is using Shira\'s connection name. Restart the phone and try again.
